english.title: Arrange material for a foreign satellite programme
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)
arranged for **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to supply programme material, namely **(..SPECIFY MATERIAL..), to be included in a programme transmitted in the provision of a proscribed foreign satellite service, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SERVICE..).
english.legislation: Contrary to section 178(2) and (4) of the Broadcasting Act 1990.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required

english.notes:
(i) A "Proscribed" service is one proscribed by order made under section 177.
(ii) "Supply" has the meaning it is given in section 46 of the Consumer Protection Act 1987 (section 178(7)).
(iii) "Programme material" is defined in section 178(8) to include a film (within the meaning of part i of the copyright, designs and patents act 1988), any other recording and any advertisement or other advertising material.
(iv) See also offence wording: H1365.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
